verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents Git Sync for managing workspace resources programmatically, and a company comparison describes it as git version control, which a user also praises. The docs mention approvals as a governance control, giving some review support, but no explicit rollback or restore-to-prior-version workflow for syncs or journeys is documented. missing for 10: documented rollback/revert of automations, explicit version history for syncs/journeys, detail on how Git Sync supports change review (e.g. PRs), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Git Sync lets you manage workspace resources programmatically.
Hightouch offers more developer-focused features (live debugger, alerting, git version control)
